devHome.folder.label: dev-home folder
devHome.folder.help: Your dev-home folder: one that is already a dev-home. Until it's set, setup stops to ask for it.

updates.installAutomatically.label: Install dev-home-toolkit updates automatically
updates.installAutomatically.help: Whether a sync installs dev-home-toolkit updates as soon as it finds them.

updates.checkEveryHours.label: Check GitHub for dev-home-toolkit updates
updates.checkEveryHours.help: How often a sync checks GitHub for dev-home-toolkit updates. 0 checks every time.

devHome.checkEveryHours.label: Check GitHub for dev-home's changes
devHome.checkEveryHours.help: How often /handoff, plain /knowledge, and /knowledge add check GitHub for dev-home's changes in single-PC mode. In multi-PC mode they check every time. 0 checks every time.

rules.warnAboveKiB.label: Warn when your rules for one agent pass
rules.warnAboveKiB.help: The size, in KiB, at which a sync warns, in a LARGE line, that your rules for one agent on this PC have grown. Every session loads them, so each KiB costs tokens in every session. 0 never warns.

codex.instructionsMaxKiB.label: Codex's instruction limit
codex.instructionsMaxKiB.help: The least each Codex home's project_doc_max_bytes is set to, in KiB: how much of AGENTS.md, from its home and the project's folders together, Codex reads before it leaves the rest out without saying so. Setup only ever raises it. With no value in config.toml, Codex reads 32 KiB.
